answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation system tied to a unique digital identity, verified through a proof-of-stake mechanism on a mesa of trusted nodes. An attacker attempting a Sybil attack would need to control a large number of identities, akin to writing a sonnet with numerous, harmonious yet distinct voices. The cost of such an attack is amplified by the requirement to hold a significant amount of cryptocurrency, akin to accumulating a large opal, making it economically infeasible for malicious actors.
